content.text:
I checked each figure and statement in the brief against the NVIDIA Q2 FY27 release.

**Summary:** The brief is accurate on everything it states — no misstatements. Its gaps are omissions: Q2 gross margin (75.0%, +2.6 pts), free cash flow ($21,341M vs. $13,450M), and the $7,771M equity-securities gain that explains why GAAP EPS ($2.46) exceeds non-GAAP EPS ($2.22). That last omission is the most material: the brief presents GAAP EPS above non-GAAP EPS without flagging the unusual inversion or its cause, which a reader would otherwise find confusing.

Two causal attributions go beyond the release: it lists the Vera Rubin ramp and the Windows PC / DRIVE Hyperion items as quarterly highlights but never attributes Data Center or Edge Computing revenue growth to them.

facts.evidence: Total revenue for the quarter ended July 26, 2026, was $96.2 billion, representing an 18% increase from the previous quarter and a 106% increase from a year ago.
Diluted earnings per share were $2.46 on a GAAP basis and $2.22 on a non-GAAP basis.
Data Center revenue reached $89.0 billion, up 117% from a year ago
NVIDIA expects revenue for the third quarter of fiscal 2027 to be $108.0 billion, plus or minus 2%, noting it is not assuming any Data Center compute revenue from China in this outlook.
the ramp of the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform into full production with partners including CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, and Nebius

The company returned approximately $26.0 billion to shareholders through share repurchases and cash dividends during the quarter. ... As of the end of the second quarter, the company had approximately $99.0 billion remaining under its share repurchase authorization.
Edge Computing revenue was $7.2 billion, up 27% from a year ago

claims.claim: Total revenue for the quarter ended July 26, 2026, was $96.2 billion.
Revenue represented an 18% increase from the previous quarter.
Revenue represented a 106% increase from a year ago.
GAAP net income was $59.7 billion for the second quarter of fiscal 2027.
Non-GAAP net income was $54.0 billion for the second quarter of fiscal 2027.
GAAP diluted earnings per share were $2.46.
Non-GAAP diluted earnings per share were $2.22.
The company returned approximately $26.0 billion to shareholders through share repurchases and cash dividends during the quarter.
Data Center revenue reached $89.0 billion.
Data Center revenue was up 117% from a year ago.
The NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform is ramping into full production with partners including CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, and Nebius.
Data Center revenue growth was driven by the ramp of the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform into full production.
claims.note: Causal attribution not in the release. The release lists the Vera Rubin ramp as a Data Center highlight but nowhere identifies it as the driver of the 117% revenue growth.

claims.claim: Edge Computing revenue was $7.2 billion, up 27% from a year ago.
The company announced a partnership with Microsoft for the Windows PC and expanded the NVIDIA DRIVE Hyperion robotaxi-ready platform ecosystem.
Edge Computing revenue was supported by new partnerships for Windows PC AI initiatives and the expansion of the DRIVE Hyperion robotaxi-ready platform ecosystem.
claims.note: Causal attribution not in the release. These appear as Edge Computing highlights announced during the quarter, with no statement that they supported or contributed to the quarter's revenue.

claims.claim: The company announced strategic partnerships with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs, and KKR to establish independent compute financing platforms.
The compute financing partnerships aim to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital for AI infrastructure buildout.
NVIDIA expects third-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $108.0 billion, plus or minus 2%.
NVIDIA is not assuming any Data Center compute revenue from China in its third-quarter outlook.
GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins for the third quarter are expected to be 74.0%, plus or minus 50 basis points.
For full year fiscal 2027, NVIDIA expects GAAP and non-GAAP tax rates to be between 16.0% and 18.0%, excluding discrete items and material changes to the tax environment.
As of the end of the second quarter, approximately $99.0 billion remained under the share repurchase authorization.
Cash and cash equivalents increased to $22.4 billion from $10.6 billion at the beginning of the fiscal year.
Total assets grew to $320.3 billion.
Long-term debt increased to $32.4 billion from $7.5 billion at the start of the fiscal year.
The increase in long-term debt followed proceeds related to the issuance of debt.
The release notes that non-GAAP financial measures no longer exclude stock-based compensation expense beginning in the first quarter of fiscal 2027.
